title: How to use Tended
intro: Tended keeps medicine schedules, reminders and a shared record in one place for patients and the people who care for them. This guide walks through every part of the app.

sections.title: Getting started
steps: Open Tended and choose Sign up (or Log in if you already have an account) from the top bar.
Enter your name, email and a password of at least 8 characters. Adding a mobile number with its country code is optional.
Choose who you are setting up the plan for: someone you care for, or yourself.
If you closed your account before, signing up again with the same email reopens it.

sections.title: Adding a patient
steps: Go to Profile and press Add patient (or Add my profile for your own medicines).
Enter the name, relationship, date of birth, conditions, doctor and notes. Photos can be taken with the in-app camera.
Add the patient's mobile number with its country code; it becomes a tap-to-call link.
Optionally add the patient's email. When they sign in with that email they get a read-only view of their own plan.

sections.title: Adding a medicine
steps: Open Medicines and press Add medicine.
Enter the name and strength, choose the form (pill, syrup, drops, inhaler, injection, powder) and what it is for. Choose Other to type a condition that isn't listed.
Choose how much to take per dose: tablet fractions like ½ or ¼, millilitres for syrup, drops, puffs or units. This is required.
Pick how often and the start date, then add each dose time with the hour, minute and AM/PM. There is no default time; times that already passed today are not allowed (use Start from tomorrow).
Enter how many doses you have and when to be reminded to refill, then save.

sections.title: Taking doses on the Today screen
steps: Doses are grouped into Morning, Afternoon, Evening and Night, like a pill organizer.
A dose that is due right now has a glowing border. Press Take or Skip; each dose can be marked from its time until one hour after.
Made a mistake? Press Undo while the dose is still open.
Taken, skipped and missed doses are counted separately in the progress ring and bar. Each dose shows who recorded it.

sections.title: Rescheduling
steps: Press Reschedule on a dose (or on a medicine card).
Choose Just this dose to move one dose to a new date and time, or Whole schedule to change the medicine's times from a date onwards.
Enter a reason; it is required and saved in the change history.
The moved dose shows a Rescheduled badge and Changed history; everyone caring for the patient is notified.

sections.title: Pausing and resuming
steps: Press the pause button on a medicine card, or use Pause a medicine in Calendar.
Choose a reason (for example Doctor advised or Side effects), then confirm a second time.
Paused medicines show a Paused badge. Press Resume on the card to start again.

sections.title: History and change log
steps: History shows every dose with its patient, time, outcome and who recorded it, as a timeline or a table.
Filter by patient, medicine, dates or time of day.
The Changes view lists every change (reschedules, pauses, edits, undo) with who made it, when and why.
Rescheduled medicines have a Change history button covering all their versions.

sections.title: Medical history and prescription scanning
steps: Open a patient and choose Medical history to see diagnoses, prescriptions, procedures, allergies and results on a timeline.
Press Scan prescription, take a photo or upload an image or PDF, and AI reads the date, doctor, diagnosis and medicines.
AI can make mistakes, especially with handwriting. Always check every field against the original before saving; nothing is saved until you confirm.
You can also add, edit or delete entries by hand and view the original document.

sections.title: Attachments and photos
steps: Add prescriptions, reports and photos to a patient (JPEG, PNG, HEIC, PDF or Excel, up to 10 MB).
Press any attachment to preview it: zoom images, read PDFs and view Excel sheets as tables.
The Camera button asks for permission, shows a live preview and lets you retake before using a photo.

sections.title: Family sharing
steps: Create a family in Profile, then Family. You become its admin. A person can belong to one family only.
Invite people by their exact email address. They see the family's patients only after accepting.
Invitations can be accepted or declined from the bell or the Family page; the inviter and the admin are told the answer.
The admin can let members add and remove people, hand over the admin role, remove members and edit the family name and picture.

sections.title: Patient view (linked accounts)
steps: If a patient record has your email, signing in shows that plan in view-only mode: medicines, history, schedule and your caregivers' contact details.
Your caregiver can allow you to mark your own doses as taken or skipped.
Full access returns when your caregiver removes your email from the patient record.

sections.title: Reminders and notifications
steps: Every notification appears in the bell. Invitations can be answered there directly.
In Profile, then Notifications, choose when the first reminder arrives and how often it repeats (never longer than the first reminder).
Press Enable alerts on this device, then Send test. The checklist shows exactly what is missing if alerts don't arrive.
On iPhone or iPad, first use Share, then Add to Home Screen, and open Tended from there.

sections.title: Your account
steps: Edit your name, photo and phone number in Profile, then Edit details.
Close account signs you out everywhere and moves care plans to another caregiver when possible. Signing up again with the same email reopens it.
System admins can switch features on or off for everyone or for one user from Profile, then Feature flags.

disclaimer: Tended helps organize medicine routines. It does not provide medical advice, diagnosis or treatment. Always follow your doctor's or pharmacist's instructions.
